claims.text: The opportunity is for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers.

The earliest start date for the fellowship is 1 March 2027.

The British Academy has been funded by the Department of Science, Innovation & Technology (DSIT) to support the Innovation Fellowships.
The objective is to provide opportunities for researchers to develop skills, networks, and careers in specific sectors to address challenges requiring innovative approaches and solutions.
Researchers will be supported to create new and deeper links beyond academia, enabling knowledge mobilization and translation, as well as individual skills development.
This is the fourth call for this programme.
Opportunities are for Global Innovation Fellowship award holders to embed themselves and be based in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin.
The aim is a mutually beneficial partnership between the fellowship award holder and DGAP.
Applications are invited in the areas of Security, Defence, and Resilience in a New Threat Environment; Indo-European Relations; Technology and AI; and Strategy-Making in Europe.

Applicants do not need an understanding of German politics but should offer new approaches to foreign policy dilemmas and engage with policymakers in Germany.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews as a mandatory part of the assessment process.

Fellowships are expected to commence by September 2027, with an earlier start date of March or April 2027 possible.
The Academy is offering up to two one-year fellowships.
